name: Bors de Ganis

attributes.attribute: one of three who reached the Grail

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bors de Ganis is an Arthurian hero. He sat among the knights of the Round Table. He was the cousin of the lord Lancelot. The Grail is a sacred cup. Only three knights were pure enough to reach it. They were Percival, Galahad, and Bors de Ganis. Bors was the least known of the three.

okr.objective: Describe Bors de Ganis, the least known of the three Grail knights.
key_results: Bors de Ganis was an Arthurian hero.
He was the cousin of Lancelot.
Only three knights reached the Grail.
The three were Percival, Galahad, and Bors de Ganis.
